The auditor will examine these documents to ensure that they are accurate, comply with the Hong Kong Financial Reporting Standards (HKFRS), and reflect the true financial position of the company.
A typical statutory audit for a small or medium-sized company may take 1–2 weeks, while audits for larger companies may take several weeks to complete.
